title: What Does a Harness Repair? A Preregistered Study of Visibility, Baseline Adequacy and Evaluation Defects
initial_evidence_boundary: Read the cached official v1 body and source-version marker only. No later paper version, current summary or today primary/parent scope judgement read before this initial. Scope and selected visible summary numbers are audited; underlying outputs, intervals, whole-paper experiments and code execution are not reproduced.

scope_advice.why_zh: 原文专门研究冻结模型外围Harness搜索的收益归因与评估缺陷，并实际用执行/评分反馈严格改进提示、冻结选中的提示后在独立分区重用。属于Harness专项评测；评测程序本身无需自我改写。

evidence.quote: The study uses the weights unmodified and redistributes neither benchmark item text nor model weights.
edited two text components and nothing else: the system prompt, which replaces the row’s system message
acceptance only on strict improvement; perfect-score minibatches skipped; no merging; no evaluation cache.

The proposer sees a row’s user message, the task model’s output, reasoning and answer, and feedback (correct, incorrect, unparsed, or cut at the token limit); it never sees the gold or a replication or test row.

The selected texts were recorded, with their SHA256, before the harness was run on any replication row. Each was then run on every letter row of the replication and test partitions, on the main server with its start’s request parameters.
it says nothing about searching the thinking switch, the token limits or retry rules.
The items are split into search, replication and test partitions (40/20/40);
GEPA searches on the search partition only.
Table 3 gives the 31 endpoints of H1–H3 and Table 4 the 16 pairs of H4
AUTHORS-1500 is non-inferior to RESCUE-1500 in 7 of nine cells and to all four GEPA harnesses.
GEPA searched prompt text only (Appendix J ), repaired its broken starts, and found no harness whose accuracy differs detectably from the thinking-off baseline’s.
The claim holds in six pairs: the broken start in all three models, the unparsed-as-A scoring in SmolLM3-3B and Intern-S1-mini , and the gold fallback in Qwen3-1.7B-Longevity .
The study covers three small models, three pools and six defects chosen from one line of work, so H4 says how replication behaves for these defects and not for the space of defects.
BUDGET-512-1500 differs from THINK-512 in two ways at once: vLLM ends thinking after 512 tokens, and the total allowance is 2,012 tokens against 512.
Our intervals resample participant components (items in the two general pools) at a frozen harness, zero temperature and fixed prompts, so they cover item sampling and not prompt or judge variance
earlier work had called most LongevityBench rows with other configurations, callers and one model variant, and the rows the case study had held out are excluded.
Seven replication rows are both in the reading’s sample and among the defect-A rows, and we flagged them and left them out of every analysis, whether or not anyone tried.
The study’s repository is not public at present.
The freeze time is recorded only in the authors’ private repository, in the hash file that the freeze commit adds, and it is not independently timestamped.
The run logs hold benchmark item text and model outputs and will not be released.

numeric_readback.method: Count visible official-table verdicts and read printed numeric values; no re-execution or statistical recomputation.

H2.meaning: AUTHORS-1500 non-inferiority, not equality: 7 of 9 rescue comparisons plus 4 GEPA comparisons. Two GSM8K rescue comparisons fail; one replication label is inconclusive.

H4.meaning: Six distortions meet the general preregistered rule on both samples; do not equate all defects with replication failures. Alternate narrower rule changes one fails label to inconclusive, not the six holds.

GEPA.scope_limit: Four prompt-only searches, one proposer; not a general claim that all Harness evolution fails.

summary_suggestion.summary_zh: 专项审计冻结模型的Harness搜索，区分答案可读性恢复、弱基线与评估缺陷。GEPA依据执行反馈改写提示，在搜索集选定后冻结到复核/测试分区；四次提示搜索均未超过关闭思考的基线。结论限于该搜索空间；原版本仓库未公开，冻结时间缺少独立时间戳。
summary_suggestion.summary_en: A targeted audit of frozen-model harness search distinguishes answer-visibility repairs, weak baselines and evaluation defects. GEPA revises prompts from execution feedback, selects on search rows and freezes the artifact before replication/test use. None of four prompt-only searches exceeds the thinking-off baseline; the result is specific to this search space. This version has no public repository or independent timestamp for the freeze.

publication_cautions: Keep v1 numbers and source hash; do not import later-version text or results.
Different token allowances confound H3; do not call the comparisons matched-budget.
Previously contacted LongevityBench rows and the seven excluded leaked-hash rows limit pristine-holdout claims.
Preregistration and ancillary copies do not independently prove freeze time.
Private code and unreleased row-level logs are stated limitations, not proof of an unavailable official article.
Formal date binding, future summary comparison and publication actions remain parent responsibilities.
